slides.alt: The German airship Hindenburg, its tail engulfed in a huge ball of flame, hangs nose-up beside the Lakehurst mooring mast as tiny figures run below.
slides.credit: Photograph: public domain, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.alt: The Hindenburg moored to the tall mast at Lakehurst, its long silver hull stretching across the airfield. Overlay text reads '97 people on board'.
slides.credit: US National Archives, NARA 518856. Public domain.

slides.alt: The Hindenburg's passenger lounge, rows of seats and long windows along a curved wall. Overlay text reads 'Filled with hydrogen'.
slides.credit: Nationaal Archief, via Wikimedia Commons. No known restrictions.

slides.alt: Flames consume the Hindenburg's hull as the airship hangs nose-up beside the Lakehurst mast. Overlay text reads '34 seconds'.
The burnt framework of the Hindenburg collapsed on the airfield at Lakehurst, seen from a distance. Overlay text reads '36 died'.
The Hindenburg's wreckage burning on the ground as figures stand around it. Overlay text reads 'The end of the airship era'.
Dark closing card with the Cluefolio logo and wordmark, the message 'Follow for the machines that changed history, and the failures that ended them', and a button reading FOLLOW @CLUEFOLIO.
